stem.text: A ball drops onto a horizontal surface and bounces elastically.
What happens to the kinetic energy of the ball during the very short time that it is in contact with the surface?

A.text: Most of the kinetic energy is lost as heat and sound.

B.text: The kinetic energy decreases to zero and then returns to its original value.

C.text: The kinetic energy remains constant because it is an elastic collision.

D.text: The kinetic energy remains constant in magnitude but changes direction.
